Warranty & returns

  • 7-day guarantee on all tested mechanical parts — engines, gearboxes, diffs.
  • Body panels, doors, bumpers and interior trim are sold as inspected. Photos show the actual item.
  • Faulty part inside 7 days: we replace it or refund you in full.
  • Fitment is the buyer's responsibility — always check the part number against your VIN before ordering.

Delivery

  • Collection from our Benoni yard — free.
  • Courier via The Courier Guy for main centres; heavy items (engines, gearboxes) quoted per consignment.
  • Payment by EFT or cash on collection. Goods released once payment reflects.
